headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.smallCell_card_incidence
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ),
  Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) +
      Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.RepairSmallRows r U) *
        Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.RepairSmallColumns c U) =
    n * Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.RepairSmallRows r U) +
      m * Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.RepairSmallColumns c U)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance_twice
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ),
  Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) -
      1 ≤
    2 * Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCorrectionSuccess_linear
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference →
    have p :=
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys)));
    1 / (4 * ↑p) ≤ Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCorrectionSuccess xs ys
